80s-transmigration-the-young-widows-hust:
Lin Lan transmigrated into a book set in the 80s and became a young widow with a child.
As soon as she opened her eyes, someone was at her door demanding payment of debts, and when she went out, she was met with the disdainful and contemptuous gazes of her neighbors!
She, a person who had owned a house and a shop through her own efforts, would she fail in the 80s?
Facing external threats and internal difficulties, she picked up the skills from her past life, selling spiced broad beans and pea cakes outside, opening a shop...
Her sister-in-law said, “Lin Lan, that man is not bad. He's strong and very family-oriented.”
“No time, I'm busy with my business.”
Her maternal aunt said, “You're just a widow, what are you being picky for? He's a 'ten-thousand-yuan household,' he doesn't mind that you have a child, you should be content!”
A ten-thousand-yuan household! Heh heh!
A certain man watched the busybody matchmakers who came to introduce partners to Lin Lan, his eyes gleaming with a cold light, as he strove to pursue his wife!
a-western-doctors-happy-farming-life: When Song Qinghan woke up, he found that he had not only transmigrated into another world, but also… had a ball in his stomach. He thought the original owner of this body had left a total mess to him. But it turned out there was a piece of precious jade hidden in it. Looking at the six-pack abs of Wu Dahu, he rubbed his hands with great excitement. Farming, your job! Hunting, your job! Giving birth, ahem, you worked hard! But surgery… leave it to me!
after-bankruptcy-the-billionaire-asked-m:
Ye Family goes bankrupt, and her fiancé's family watches coldly.
Ye Li signs a contract and marries her fiancé's uncle in a flash marriage.
After marriage, Ye Li is determined to repay the debt of one hundred million with interest, hoping to give Fu Yanci freedom so he can be with his true love.
When it reaches 5 million, Fu Yanci gets upset.
At 50 million, Fu Yanci leaves home for three days.
When finally paying off the full one hundred million, Ye Li is cornered by the man: 'Divorce, huh? Sure!!! The family property is yours, and so am I! I'll follow you everywhere!'
Ye Li: ......
after-being-framed-by-her-family-she-was:
Jing Yao slept with the CEO from a rich family who was rumored to stay away from women. She even got pregnant. Jing Yao grew up not receiving any love from her parents. Although she and her sister were twins, she looked nothing like her older sister. Her parents favored her older sister.
Jing Yao was forced to start working at a young age, while her sister could stay at home and do nothing. Jing Yao had to pay her own tuition fees. A single purse her sister owned cost several tens of thousand. Not only that, but her older sister even got together with her fiance, whom she had been engaged to since they were children.
Formally speaking, Jing Yao was the second sister in the family. However, in reality, she was so poor that she couldn’t even pay her own rent. Her family had never shown her any care or affection.
For the sake of her older sister’s marriage, Jing Yao’s biological mother set her up by making her drink with an investor. She was even drugged. Fortunately, she was alert enough to run away. However, she ran in the wrong direction. As a result, she ended up sleeping with Liang Xun.
After returning home, Jing Yao’s mother yelled at her. Her jerk of a fiance humiliated her.…
after-leaving-the-team-the-adventurer-la:
Lin Da, a former professional player, arrived in the game “Mystic Continent” and aimed to team up with a few “Young Ladies” from Another World to conquer fifty levels of Mystic Realm and become the strongest adventurer squad.
However, ever since the team had risen to fame, they had changed somewhat.
“Why is your healing so slow? I almost got killed by the Magical Creatures.”
“The reason your level is so low is that you don’t train diligently, always have crooked thoughts about us. This 23-year-old guy is so disgusting.”
“Better leave the team and become my servant instead; my pet dog just needs a playmate.”
The attitude of the three Young Ladies chilled Lin Da’s heart, and he opted out of this team that he had been with for three years and had grown deeply fond of.
Only then did they realize who the core of the team really was.
When they regretted their actions too late and tried to apologize to Lin Da, seeking to join his team, Lin Da glanced at the team composed of prettier and hotter beautiful girls behind him and said helplessly:
“Sorry, my team is full.”
alphas-regret-rejected-pregnant-and-clai:
“Burn me alive, Maeve. Hurt me. Break me! But don’t go — don’t fucking go — don’t make me live in a world where you’re not mine.”
Maeve was the scrawny mate Alpha Ivan never wanted. He was unfeeling. His family mocked her. His pack shamed her. And when she miscarried their child, he called her careless—then made her best friend his breeder.
Maeve left that night without a word. But what no one knew? She was still pregnant. A miracle from the goddess.
Years later, Ivan is seconds from crowning his breeder as Luna and claiming the Alpha throne… when Maeve walks into the ceremony. Not the weak girl he threw away—but the kingdom’s most famous healer, rivaled by none, with a child who looks just like him.
The bond he thought was dead still exists. The mate he rejected? Stronger than ever. And the heir he thought he lost? Still very much alive.
Now Ivan wants them back. But Maeve didn’t return for love. She came to destroy the empire that spit her out. And this time, she’s not alone. She has his greatest enemy by her side.
arcane-heir-historys-strongest-mage:
Michael Aurelius, the young heir to the Aurelius family is a white-ringed mage, the weakest and most pitiful mage in existence. Capable of only performing chore magic, he is deemed worthless despite being born into the noble and respected Aurelius family.
Yet things take a turn when tragedy strikes, leaving the young and weak mage alone, fighting for his life in the mana-scarred lands. A mysterious power awakens within Michael, giving him a glimpse of the strength he had always been yearning for.
But all is not as it seems. With most of the arcane knowledge lost due to the great war two-thousand years ago, civilization has yet to recover.
Read along as Michael begins his journey towards his ultimate goal—strength.
Because only by being strong will he be able to exact revenge on those who have wronged him. Only then can he surpass those who mocked him.
big-shot-little-jiaojiao-breaks-her-pers:
The daughter of the Chi family has been living in the mountains for sixteen years. Suddenly, she returns to the White City. However, it’s soon found out that this missy’s image is a little off.On the first day, the paparazzi catches her having a meal with one of the best actors. The photographs quickly top the hot searches.
Best Actor: Don’t make wild guesses. She is my boss and I am her underling.
Netizens: As if we would believe you!
The next day, the paparazzi catches a financial tycoon tying her shoelaces in the middle of the street. This goes onto the hot searches once again.Some financial tycoon: Don’t make wild guesses. She is my boss and I am her underling.
Netizens: (⊙…⊙)On the third day, the Chi family’s missy dominates the hot searches again with paparazzi photos of a big shot in the medical field sending her to school.
Big shot in the medical field: I’m sorry, but she is my boss.

Just as the netizens are gradually getting used to Chi Jiao’s antics, the paparazzi catches her walking into the Civil Affairs Bureau with the head of the Quan family, Quan Jue.…
black-quantiarch-the-progenitors-odyssey:
The Hollow Woods is an enigmatic forest that spans across the entire Northern Continent of Elytheria.
Down below is a sprawling underground network of caverns and tunnels inhabited by Unique monster and magical beast.
A society of beings who evolve by killing and devouring each other.
...
In such an environment was born Black in the network of caverns down below —
Not knowing anything about who, what and where he was —
However with a Unique System that is connected to his very Race — “The Quantiarch”
Watch as his adventures begans while he traverse the underground cavern's —
Slowly reaching the ground above —
Meeting different, Unique Spirits, The Elves, The Humen, The Demon, and many other unique Races — all the while increasing his kin in the process —
It is the journey of a Proginetor, even though born unknown. Born weak — Becoming an existence feared by all and the world's beyond.…
blackstone-code:
If life could repeat itself, what would you do?
Would you repeat your first life and stay a normal average joe? Perhaps your gaze will betray the life you’ve already lived, but you remain insignificant and unknown, stretching your neck up high to watch the furling clouds roll by?
Or will you make the world your stage, stir up every cloud and wind under all the heavens, making the entire world your captive audience as you dance, making people’s hearts pound with your every move?
Composing my own laws, establishing the order I desire…a human life is a measly ten decades, so why don’t I light the candle that is my life and set this world ablaze!!
chongfei-manual:
Before her rebirth, Wei Luo was an innocent little girl.
After rebirth, she appeared lovable on the outside but was a different person on the inside.
Those who learned of her true nature yielded to her.
Only the prince regent regarded her as a treasure; no matter how much he pampered her, it was not enough for him.
Anything she wanted, he gave her, including the princess position that she didn’t want, which he stubbornly pushed onto her.

daddy-come-home-for-dinner:
The Zhekova family's young master approached Cindy Clarke with an old phone and said, “You dropped this five years ago, and I picked it up. Do you still deny it?”
Five years ago, she was set up and got pregnant.
Cindy Clarke never imagined that the father of her son would turn out to be the Prince Charming that the entire nation loved.
She had a weak father, a scheming mother, and a sister plotting to harm her?
None of that mattered!
Adrian Zhekova said, “Whatever they want, I'll give it all to you. Let them be jealous.”
If her opponents slandered Cindy Clarke?
Adrian Zhekova said, “I'll shut down their account.”
Don't like it? Endure it!
Morgan Clarke said, “Sob, sob... Arthur Woods says I'm an illegitimate child without a dad.”
After the Woods family went bankrupt, Adrian Zhekova turned to Cindy Clarke and asked, “When are you going to make us official?”
Cindy Clarke replied, “Since I met you, it's been like having a cheat code. Everything goes my way.”
Adrian Zhekova replied, “That's right, I'm that cheat code.”
deity-hero-me-gaining-disciples-makes-me:
Xuan Yi was transported into the fictional world and became an elder of the Black Sword Sect! The moment he entered the world, he was at the Sea-Splitting Rank! He awakened his disciple accepting system. The more absurdly powerful his disciple, the stronger Xuan Yi would become! Others may depend on cultivation to raise their ranks, he raised his by accepting disciples! Although he was an elder, had anyone ever seen an elder whose strength was hundreds or even thousands of times higher than that of the sect leader?
”Little Girl, I noticed that your skeletal structure is astonishing indeed. You will be a prodigy in the Way of the Sword. Why don’t you let me be your teacher? You can pick whatever saint-grade skills to learn. I also have ninth-grade elixirs for you to eat like snacks.”
”Ding. Congratulations to master for obtaining a disciple with potential over 9999. Rewards: a rank increase of ten levels, and three saint-grade skills!”

doted-by-the-regent-king: Before Wufu was reborn, she had no idea there was such a thing as rebirth. Only after her rebirth did she realize Heaven must have thought her previous life was too smooth, so it sent her to suffer in this ancient land where morality, decency, and the Female Precepts were held in high esteem, pitiful indeed! From being a master jade carver to having her soul transmigrate into a farm girl with a wretched background, she was bullied and humiliated. Even the bun-selling mother advised her that forbearance is gold? Bullshit! She could endure, but her other identity absolutely could not—robbers, swept away; insults to her mother, you're crippled... Wufu has a saying, for every insult and humiliation, I will repay a hundredfold. But what's with this one? He doesn't bully her; he only wants to sleep with her? And he even dares... to mount her? Well, a lord can endure, but Wufu cannot. Mount him back, life or death, a hundred years, neither owes the other anything!

genius-summoner:
When she opens her eyes again, she is in a strange world, a new continent.
Born in the declining Yun family and being beaten to death by the son of a powerful family—this is her identity this life.
Her father and brother, who had protected her as if their lives depended on it, becomes her strength to continue living.
The great family fortune attracts a fatal disaster from greedy people.
Since she is reborn as Yun Feng, no one can touch the Yun family!
Whoever steals the Yun family’s assets would pay back five times the amount!
Whoever plots against Yun family’s lives would pay back ten times the amount!
If there are still people who dare to touch the Yun family, she would definitely return the favor with all her strength. She would not rest until she’s dead!
Therefore, she chooses to stand up without any hesitation! From then on, the continent would lose a good-for-nothing and gain an exceptional genius!
Is it very difficult for a warrior to advance? Sorry, I have a secret treasure to temper my body. I can advance two levels in three days.
Is a mage very powerful? I’m sorry, I don’t care. She senses the five elements, and an all-elemental mage is quietly born.…
heavenly-dungeon-my-subordinates-are-all:
Ragnar Lindgren thought he was nothing more than an ordinary man wasting his days playing a game called Dungeon Maker, a game where players could either become adventurers and conquer dungeons or become Dungeon Masters and build them.
Then, during a raid by one of the world's strongest adventurer groups, something impossible happened.
As Ragnar watched his dungeon's final boss fall, a sword suddenly pierced through his monitor and struck him.
When he opened his eyes again, everything had changed.
In this world, humans see dungeons as nothing more than resources, places filled with monsters, treasures, and opportunities for wealth and power.
But Ragnar sees things differently.
If humans see dungeons as resources, then Ragnar will see humans as resources as well. Resources that will help him grow stronger.
With the help of his system, Ragnar will build the strongest dungeon this world has ever seen. Of course, he won't be doing it alone. By his side are his loyal subordinates, though, for some strange reason, the system seems determined to give him nothing but female monsters.
And they all have one thing in common. They're completely in love with Ragnar.…

Ren wakes up inside a novel that he was reading before his death. Ren possessed a character that was never once mentioned in the original novel.

Suddenly Ren awakens a mysterious system which lets him cultivate in a world of magic. He vows to become the strongest in the world but somehow ended up stealing the protagonist harem, his mom and childhood friend.

madman:

Its edges were worn, as though it had been carried for many years, yet the seal remained intact.
Gok, known for his stoicism and strength, had written it long before the final battle, anticipating that one day his journey would reach its end.
magic-world-entry-i-can-turn-wishes-into:
In an era where the Magic World can be entered by those who succeed in the Magic Awakening, everyone competes fiercely—willing to pay 1,500 dollars for each attempt, even without any guarantee of success.
Mateo, a village boy who moved to the city for college, is one of the few who has never tried—simply because he couldn’t afford it.
His dormmate suggests another way.
A wealthy woman is willing to sponsor him… for free.
But in exchange, he must fulfill her request: to become her boyfriend.
Unexpectedly, Mateo succeeds on his very first attempt.
He awakens the Heaven Path Soul—an SSS-Class Talent capable of influencing the very Path of Heaven according to his will, as long as it has enough energy.
Entering the Magic World without understanding what he possesses, Mateo soon discovers something strange—
Some of his wishes… begin to come true on their own.

marvels-master-of-cosmic-magic:
Rowan Mercer was never meant to exist. Born in a covert mutant lab as Subject 757, he was engineered from the genes of Professor X and Magneto, then dismissed as a failure before he ever learned what he was capable of. His telepathy is faint, his magnetism weak, and the scientists who built him see him as little more than a disposable prototype.
But Rowan is not alone in his own skin.
The night he tries to sleep off another brutal training session, something in him fractures. His consciousness splits open, anchoring him to a second body in a different world entirely—an abused orphan in the shadows of Knockturn Alley, just days away from entering the wizarding world.
Two bodies. Two lives. One mind.
And then Rowan discovers the real impossibility:
Every ability he trains in one world strengthens him in the other.
Magic fuels mutation. Mutation fuels magic. And each new universe waiting beyond these two is another life ready to awaken.
With X-23 preparing to lead a desperate escape, the wizarding world whispering of ancient power, and the multiverse itself unfolding like a map only he can read, Rowan begins to understand the truth:
He isn’t a failed experiment.…
medical-sovereign:

After graduating from college, he stayed in Ninghai City and tried to seek a job in a hospital there, but things did not go well at first. However, he accidentally saved Shen Muqing who was from a rich and powerful family, and then got involved in the confrontation between Ninghai special police team and a mysterious organization called Vampire Mercenary Group in order to protect Ling Yun who was his landlord’s daughter. It became the turning point of his life. After that, he started an incredible adventure during which he would find out the real identities of his father and masters and discover the secrets behind the mysterious organization Vampire Mercenary Group and the special weapons and tactics team Dragon Soul...
The story tells about how he opened nine apertures, fought with rogues, chased after various pretty girls and established a rich and powerful family by himself. He climbed up to the peak of his life step by step, and finally became medical sovereign.

Jiang Changsheng was reincarnated as the crown prince of the Jing Kingdom. However, he was switched at birth and was sent to grow up in a temple. He was raised as a Taoist.
